title: SB775 (2017 Regular): Relating to criminal background check exemption for concealed handgun licensees.

provenance.note: Introduced version; no votes on file. The rest of ORS 166.435 (private transfers must go through a gun dealer; Class A misdemeanor for failure) is reprinted unchanged by the digest. Quoted item is one of the exceptions listed in subsection (4).

operative_text: SECTION 1 (ORS 166.435): (e) The transfer of a firearm to a person licensed under ORS 166.291 and 166.292 to carry a concealed handgun.
